name: r3b_mild_hvac_fan_sleep_sensor_swap
description: Mild day, HVAC fan, a bedroom sensor is configured: the plan says CA reads it from bedtime and the thermostat again at wake.
notes: Issue #1230 R3b Tier A golden candidate (pending: owner approves, DP-11). The scenario sets capture_next_action, so the harness records the occupant surfaces at the end of the run (engine_state._next_action: Next Action text, Next Automation, the operation timeline's steps, the briefing Windows row). Every assertion below reads that capture through the existing field_equals assertion: outcomes.py is unchanged.

Tier A has no learned thermal model and no forecast: the engine's window recommendation therefore stands unvalidated (confidence low), and the timeline carries only what the classification event states.

assertions.reason: the Next Action and Next Automation cards read the operation timeline (not the degraded legacy path)
the Next Action card text the occupant reads
whether the card tells the occupant to open windows
the card never invites a window the timeline does not hold
the Next Automation card's action is the earliest automation-executed timeline step still ahead
the Next Automation card's time is that step's time
the timeline step the card came from (None when the plan holds no window step today)
the occupant steps the plan holds (today, then tomorrow's engine plan)
D1: the engine's own recommendation is unvalidated in Tier A (no learned window effect), so low
the briefing's Windows row reads the same window periods
the plan names the sensor change at bedtime and wake
